text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand and interpret visual information from the world, much like humans do. One of its core functions is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a photo, such as a cat, a tree, or a person. A more advanced task is object detection, which not only recognizes objects but also locates them within an image, often drawing a box around each one. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision processes camera feeds in real time to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and traffic signs, allowing the car to make safe decisions. Beyond transportation, it is used in medical imaging to spot diseases and in security systems to recognize faces. As this technology improves, it continues to change how we interact with machines and the world around us.
